checkRuns.command: sed -i "s#^import { checkContact } from '../contact'#import { ActionError } from 'kay'\nimport { checkContact } from '../contact'#" src/components/contact-form.kay && sed -n 1,8p src/components/contact-form.kay && bun run check

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/components/contact-form.kay'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""      if (error instanceof ActionError && error.data?.errors)
        errors.set(error.data.errors)
      else
        throw error""","""      if (!(error instanceof ActionError))
        throw error
      const data = error.data as { errors?: ContactErrors } | undefined
      errors.set(data?.errors ?? {})""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
bun run check && bun run build

cat > src/routes/_layout.kay <<'EOF'
--- server
import { books } from '../content.config'

const path = ctx.url.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '') || '/'
const bookSlug = path.startsWith('/books/') ? decodeURIComponent(path.slice('/books/'.length)) : undefined
const section = path === '/books' || (bookSlug !== undefined && await books.get(bookSlug) !== undefined)
  ? 'books'
  : path === '/about' || path === '/contact' ? path.slice(1) : undefined
---
header
  a(href="/" aria-current={undefined}) Bookshelf
  nav(aria-label="Main")
    a(href="/books" aria-current={section === 'books' ? 'page' : undefined}) Books
    a(href="/about" aria-current={section === 'about' ? 'page' : undefined}) About
    a(href="/contact" aria-current={section === 'contact' ? 'page' : undefined}) Contact
main
  slot
footer © Bookshelf
EOF
bun run check
bun run check && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -4 && bun test 2>&1 | tail -3; pkill -f "bun src/server.ts"; sleep 0.5; pgrep -af "server.ts" | grep -v pgrep; git status --short
